notes.title: Patch 0.85
notes.content:
New Features & Improvements

Added flashlight button in tutorial.

Added a second flashlight

A very dim light for Phase 2 visibility .

More tooltips added to the jumpscare screen.

All three tutorials fully rewritten for clarity.

Dialogue speed synced across the game.

Finished logic side of the ending + added a temporary ending.

Gameplay Adjustments

Coin 1 distraction time reduced.

Enemy noise level increased.

Small level tweaks for balance.

Reduced camera clipping through walls.

Bug Fixes

Fixed model inconsistencies.

Fixed reset bug (could reset without pause menu).

Fixed bug where mouse wouldn’t appear after reset to main menu.

Fixed glass breaking SFX position (now plays in correct ear).

Fixed layering issues with jumpscare image.

Replaced placeholder jumpscare image with a black screen.
